data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'vinco', meaning 'to conquer'. He was a deacon, a leader in the Church, and was known for his unwavering faith and miraculous powers. His name became synonymous with strength, courage, and the power of the spirit to overcome obstacles and challenges.

His miraculous abilities were a testimony to the power of the spirit, and his feast day remains an inspiration for Christians around the world to stand firm in their faith and to trust in the power of God to overcome any obstacle.
